description:
Find Sentry uptime monitors, which check a URL over HTTP. Returns each monitor's URL, status, interval, owner, and project.
Scheduled jobs (cron): find_monitors. Metric thresholds: find_metric_monitors.
When more results exist, narrow by project, environment, owner, or name.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug, or lowercase `all` for every project.

query.description: Text to match in the monitor name or URL.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: find_uptime_monitors
title: Find Uptime Monitors
